channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jimmy Butler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jimmy Butler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Malevy Leons
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“The beef that you never knew you needed in your life that's not a beef by the way. It's not a beef at all actually, because one of these guys would never beef with anyone. The other one would beef with someone, but there's absolutely no reason for them to beef with each other. And that is the beef that is not a beef at all, Jimmy Butler versus Malevy Leons. Malevy, there's, if you know anything about Malevy, number one is he is the greatest person you could ever meet in your life. He walks in with a smile every day. He is a hard-ass worker, absolutely incredible person. However, if you also know Malevy, you know he raw dogs everything.”

Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Malevy Leons, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr explained Thursday after practice at BYU-Hawaii.

“One of the rookies picked Jimmy (Butler), and Jimmy was like, ‘Hell yeah, I’ll shoot those free throws!'”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Oct 2, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“The first team we play against is the Clippers, and if we win, the Minnesota gets into the playoffs after 16 years. Jimmy Butler has been there, Derrick Rose has been there, all these different players have been there, high-level players, all-star, Jeff Teague, all-star caliber type players, and Minnesota has never been there. Andthen you inject Pat Bev in there and we're playing with a number seven seed.”

Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Dillon Brooks says he would want to Box Jimmy Butler ?

“Jimmy Butler. It’s all about basketball for sure. But I feel like some things went to far. I always feel the animosity”

Dillon Brooks on Jimmy Butler, Jul 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking over the last few years, playing it for the post-Steph era. And listen, there's always going to be backlash when you're not winning. It happens to everyone. That's just what comes with the territory. But I don't think going to trade for Jimmy Butler would be considered lack of taking risks, especially signing him to a two-year $121 million extension. I don't think that would be considered a lack of taking risk. I also don't believe that trading for Dennis Schroeder, trying to make something happen, is a lack of taking risk.”

Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on what they’ll miss about Jimmy Butler:

“We’re not going to get to the foul line nearly asoften…I’m guessing Jimmy goes to the line eight times a game. I’m not sure we can replace more than a couple of those.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Jan 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jonathan Kuminga on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Jonathan Kuminga on playing his best, getting hurt and coming back to a different team with Butler:

“It was tough. Playing great and then things like that happen. I just tried to get better. I had to figure out how to be impactful. I didn't put my head down... I had tough moments”

Jonathan Kuminga on Jimmy Butler, May 15, 2025. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on Jimmy Butler:

“There was a lot of chatter of whether it was the right trade... From the first game in Chicago to last night, it was a seamless fit.(We) complement each other so well. He gave us so much belief... It was a success. Now you have to build off that.”

Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler, May 15, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler (nine shots tonight):

“He wasn’t as aggressive tonight but I didn’t see a lot of openings.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, May 13, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler:

“No, I'm not going to apologize for saying no to on the contract extension.”

Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler, May 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Pat Riley on the Jimmy Butler fiasco and telling him to keep his mouth shut last May:

“There’s no doubt what happened with Jimmy had a tremendous impact on our team. The buck stopped with me. I’ll take that hit. What happened in the regular season, I don’t want to discuss.”

Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler, May 9, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Erik Spoelstra on Jimmy Butler:

“It was a good five-year run. ... It didn't have to go to that level. But we have clarity now. We've turned the page.”

Erik Spoelstra on Jimmy Butler, Apr 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler entering G5:

“He said he’s doing fine. I’m sure he’s still in pain, but he’s ready to play.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Apr 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler's Game 4 status:

“He's literally day-to-day. ... I have no idea right now if he's going to play.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Apr 26, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the Jimmy Butler impact:

“We have the movement and the flow of Steph. But we've also become a great iso team. We've never been an iso team. There's great advantage to that -- to be able to get to the line, generate offense without having to set a million screens.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Apr 16, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler’s scoring (16.9 ppg on 11 FGA with the Warriors):

“What’s our record with Jimmy? (22-6). I’m good with everything Jimmy Butler is doing. We know who he is.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Apr 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the Jimmy Butler return environment:

“Miami is a great place to live. People don’t ever seem too amped up around here. So it really wasn’t that rabid an environment. Typical Miami. The main part of Jimmy’s return is that the Heat were ready.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Mar 25, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
“It’s something that everyone’s kind of been anticipating, not necessarily that we ever knew it would be Jimmy Butler [coming]. But we knew it would be somebody of that magnitude and that we were going after. And so [it was] just kind of letting him know the excitement that we’re all looking forward to him joining.”

Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Mar 13, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
“We haven’t done anything spectacular offensively. We haven’t put in a bunch of sets offensively (for Butler). I don’t think he’s necessarily coming back to a completely different offense. I think he’s coming back to a team with a completely different mentality. He’ll be fine picking that up.”

Draymond Green on Jimmy Butler, Feb 27, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on the charged up arena environment today in the first home game since Warriors traded for Jimmy Butler:

“You can tell our fans see the difference. They feel the momentum just like we do.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Feb 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on Jimmy Butler:

“He’s like the exact opposite player of me. I took 16 3s and he shot one. He got to the free throw line a lot, dominated the paint. I dominate the perimeter. It has the potential to be really fun.”

Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler, Feb 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Tyler Herro, on what he will remember about his time with Jimmy Butler:

“I think it was a great five or six years to be able to play with a guy like that. I came in as a rookie. He took me under his wing. “I took some things from him and reinvented my own way to help lead this organization in my own way. I thought it was a great five, six years of what we were able to accomplish, obviously not being able to win a championship with him. It’s a new chapter and we feel like we are headed in that direction again.”

Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler, Feb 7, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Duane Rankin:Bradley Beal on his mentality now that Jimmy Butler got traded to Golden State:

“Nothing changed for me. My mentality is the same whether somebody is here, somebody is not here. Whether I'm here, whether I'm not here. My mentality is always going to be the same, stay true to who I am. Maybe it puts people at ease. I wasn't thinking about it. Taking everything a day at a time. Once I was approached with something, the conversation would be had.”

Bradley Beal on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Curry on what adding Butler means:

“Biggest thing is just it creates expectations, which I love. I want to be in that kind of environment, whether you get it done or not, that is meaningful basketball that we all love and thrive in. I think we're all going to be up for the challenge.”

Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on the belief that the Warriors can integrate Jimmy Butler in a drama-free environment:

“Him signing an extension is big, knowing he’s committed for this next little run.”

Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on Jimmy Butler:

“I know there was a lot of drama down there (in Miami). Who really knows what the story is. We expect to have a motivated, committed Jimmy.”

Stephen Curry on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler:

“He’ll for sure play the non-Steph minutes, run our offense through him.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler:

“I’m excited to get Jimmy. He’s an elite talent. I haven’t met him yet, excited to say hello.”

Steve Kerr on Jimmy Butler, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @VinceGoodwill.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Nikola Jovic on Jimmy Butler's extension:

“I’m really happy that he got what he wanted. That bag is really big and I’m happy for him.”

Nikola Jovic on Jimmy Butler, Feb 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Ashley Nicole Moss:Victor Oladipo on Jimmy Butler/Miami Heat drama:

“It takes two to tango (...) Jimmy is just doing what Jimmy does. I don't think this is a shocker to anyone who has viewed his career.it's unfortunate, it happens.”

Victor Oladipo on Jimmy Butler, Jan 24, 2025. Source: Twitter.
